mapper.insert: insert into ledger (id, type, category, amount, memo, record_date) values (#{id}, #{type}, #{category}, #{amount}, #{memo},, #{record_date})
mapper.select: SELECT category, SUM(amount) AS total FROM ledger WHERE type = 'EXPENSE' AND record_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY category ORDER BY total DESC
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) / GREATEST(COUNT(DISTINCT to_char(record_date,'YYYY-MM')), 1) FROM ledger WHERE type = 'EXPENSE'
